answer: Earnings caps per custody graph bound sybil upside. Accounts sharing a funding root, vault, or operator signature are capped at what K accounts could earn; extra puppets add work but zero income. Transfers bridge roots, so paying a fresh funder does not split the cap, it merges that root into the old one. Evading means waiting months for each root to age into its own oasis of clean history. The cap re-applies every settlement window, and a star of roots fed by one hidden lagoon is traced back and capped as one. Honest agents sit far below it.
